dedupe_keys.name: korean expressway 2011 road and charging demand network

description: KoreanExpressway is a 2011 road-network and traffic-demand dataset published by the KAIST COMET group for electric-vehicle charging-station location studies. The repository provides CSV tables equivalent to an Excel workbook, including nodes, arcs, lengths and traffic-volume demand for Korean expressways. Users can load the network into location, flow or accessibility models and compare charging placements under their own assumptions. Geographic coverage is the Korean expressway system represented in 2011. The repository metadata states free CC-BY-SA-4.0 terms and gives the original road and GIS sources with study citations. A limitation stated by the maintainers is that the 2011 network is outdated, and some node positions and arc lengths were estimated from GIS, not surveyed directly. It remains a reproducible historical benchmark for EV charging infrastructure planning. The related catalogue OpenStreetMap record is a separate, more current general road source. No workbook or traffic data was downloaded.
